flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck; no OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code selects Letter of Advice recipients from warrants and court mention dates; only a manual notice search and data types in the UI exist (0%).
note: Synonyms tried in six repos (UI and API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, warrant of arrest, mention date, court date, court batch, last known address, work item, dashboard, OIC. No matching maintenance ticket (grep warrant / letter of advice / court = 0). Story status is blank (requirement not given); traced normally. CasIntegrationController (CAS-to-OCMS, casUpdateCourtNotices) exists but is not this feature and is not credited: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. Only found: a manual notice search by warrant_no and mention_date range in the UI (ocmsadminui/src/pages/NoticeSearch/hook/useSearch.ts:68-76, :99-110) calling the warrantofarrest and courtmention resources; no controller/entity exists for those two resources in any Java repo (only listed in api-authorization.properties:23). Notice selection for the MHA upload covers only stages RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 and LTA only stage ROV, not court/warrant stages.
recommendation: Evidence 0%. Do not claim; only a manual notice search exists, there is no automatic selection of Letter of Advice defendants.

steps.step: OCMS recognises notices updated with a warrant of arrest issued
steps.detail: Only a manual search getNoticesByWA (warrant_no regex) against the warrantofarrest resource. No job/query flags warrant notices as Letter of Advice candidates, and no warrantofarrest controller exists in any Java repo (api-authorization.properties:23 only lists the path). The resource cannot be proven from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS selects defendants based on court mention dates
steps.detail: Only a manual mention_date (gte/lte) filter against the courtmention resource for notice search. No automatic logic compares the mention date with a processing date; no courtmention controller exists in the Java repos. Not a Letter of Advice defendant selection.

steps.step: OCMS produces the list of defendant IDs to send to agencies
steps.detail: The MHA upload takes IDs from notices with nextProcessingStage RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 (MhaNricDataHelper.java:186-193); court/warrant stages (SystemConstant.java:103-106, COURT_STAGES) are not in the filter. There is no Letter of Advice specific ID list.
